_about: The tags a spec's `**Affects**:` line may name, and the stage each is owed at (the GM, 2026-10-10). A feature's stage is the EARLIEST stage among its tags - `now` when any tag is live today - so a farmhouse change tagged with every tier is owed now. A new tag is one entry here: a diagram kind not yet scripted takes its tier's stage, anything else `now`. `make speckit-todo` reads it; `make speckit-todo CHECK=1` refuses a tag not listed here.

village.about: village maps - frozen hand-drawn until the village tier is scripted

town.about: town maps - frozen hand-drawn until the town tier is scripted

provincial city.about: provincial city maps - frozen until that tier is scripted

capital.about: the capital - frozen until that tier is scripted

magistracy.about: the hand-drawn magistracy sheets (Mode A, pool/magistracies/)

country shrine.about: the hand-drawn country shrine sheets (Mode A, pool/country-shrines/)

interactive page.about: the interactive HTML map pages: hover, modals, the raster

research record.about: the research record's content: questions, drawing pages, notes, sources

research process.about: how research is done: page sessions, briefs, record checks

review process.about: the review agents, their occasions and the ledger

performance.about: what generation, the gate or a page costs in time or memory
